inlines.v: BO'VINE, adjective [Los Latin bovinus, from bos, bovis, an ox.] Pertaining to oxen and cows, or the quadrupeds of the genus bos. This animal is the strongest and fiercest of the bovine genus. The ox-born souls mean nothing more than the eight living souls, who issued from their allegorical mother, the bovine ark.
